notes.title: Handpass VR Update - 28/11
notes.content:
We've updated HandpassVR with a few features to help remove the worry of hitting controllers together along with making the ball easier to catch. 


Patch Notes:


    Added a guide showing where the ball can be picked up on the controller.
    Made the ball easier to catch
    Improved shadow realism and optimization

notes.title: Handpass VR LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
Handpass VR out now!

We're proud to announce Handpass VR has launched. Featuring more levels and more game modes, with plenty still in the works. 

Launch Update -


-Added two new levels, Space Station and TV Studio
-Updated the stadium with a new look and sky system.
-Added new game modes including Survival 
-Rearranged menu to fit the new features
-Fixed various bugs throughout the game
-General optimization
-Modified the difficulty values.

notes.title: Update - Global Leader-boards & Bug fixes
notes.content:
We've been fixing bugs and adding in features (First of many) and today we're happy to release global leader-boards shown at the end of each game. We have also fixed the occasional bug with the ball not firing from behind the target and the hand not tracking. 

Patch notes: 

- Added Global Leader-boards 
- Fixed a glitch where the ball didn't launch properly 
- Fixed tutorial text not aligning correctly 
- Fixed hand occasionally not tracking properly 


Happy Handpassing!

notes.title: HandPass VR Demo is Out!
notes.content:
Get your controllers warmed up and hands ready. Handpass VR demo is available to download NOW!  

Put on your VR headset and see if you can beat the record! A handpass is a fundamental skill in the sport of Australian Rules Football - hold the ball in one hand and punch it with the other! Handpass VR will test the accuracy of your handpasses with moving targets - and in a variety of environments
